name: September 11
overview: The events surrounding September 11 remind believers of God's sovereign protection and the assurance found in His promises. Scripture encourages us to trust that the Lord preserves us from all evil and renews our strength when we wait upon Him, as seen in Psalms 121:7 and Isaiah 40:31. Though affliction and judgment may come, God's ultimate plan includes blessing all families of the earth through His chosen people, as declared in Genesis 12:3, and the restoration symbolized by rivers flowing on high hills in times of trouble, described in Isaiah 30:25.
